item.title: The Agentic Era: What We've Learned Building AI Agents in Canada
item.description: Agents are already handing work to other agents. Canada has just made agentic AI a national priority. Here is how we strategise, plan, and build agentic workflows that survive production, and what to ask before you hire a builder.

item.title: The Bar for Writing Software Just Fell
item.description: Vibe coding makes an idea into a product in an afternoon. Agentic QA makes the machine check its own work. The ceiling moved. The floor did not, and that is where the builders who last are standing.
